notes.dataBasis: Cleaned Safeway Tyre Excel price lists uploaded for this project.
notes.patternRule: Pattern is the parent product entity; each size/configuration is a variant.
notes.customerFacingNameRule: Use the functional source name for Agriculture, OTR, and Forklift / Industrial patterns. Use the agreed category name for Motorcycle, Truck & Bus, and Three Wheeler patterns.
notes.patternIdentifierRule: patternCode remains the Safeway internal/product identifier and is displayed as a secondary identifier when a functional name exists.
notes.slugRule: Use the customer-facing functional name in the product slug where available; append the pattern code when needed for uniqueness.

nameRule.agriculture: Functional name shown with each pattern in the cleaned price list
nameRule.otr: Functional name shown with each pattern in the cleaned price list
nameRule.forklift: Functional name shown with each pattern in the cleaned price list

notes.missingValueRule: Blank source cells are represented as null. Source dash values such as '-' are preserved as strings.
notes.numericNormalization: Floating-point artifacts from spreadsheet formulas are rounded to practical displayed precision: weight to 3 decimals and FOB USD to 2 decimals.
notes.images: Pattern image is null because the uploaded Excel price lists are the structured data source; catalogue images can be linked later.
notes.scopeNote: Only patterns represented in the cleaned price lists are included. Catalogue-only patterns without corresponding price-list data are not invented.
